description.p: Time Fly is a globe of the Earth from 540 million years ago to the present. Drag the time slider to watch the continents drift, Pangaea assemble and break apart, and the ice sheets of the last ice age grow and melt, then orbit the globe to look closer.

The terrain comes from the PALEOMAP PaleoDEMs and plate model (Scotese and Wright, 2018), the ICE-6G_C ice and topography model (Peltier and colleagues) and the Spratt and Lisiecki (2016) sea-level stack. The in-game credits list the full citations.
Milestone 1 test build: the globe, the time slider and the orbit camera.
